newsitem.title: USA: Athena Medical names Peter Burke CFO.
newsitem.headline: Athena Medical names Peter Burke CFO.

text.p: Athena Medical Corp on Monday said it has named financial consultant Peter Burke as the company's chief financial officer.

Burke has been a consultant to Athena since December 1996, the company said in a statement. He has been a principal of New England Management Co, a specialist in strategic planning, operations, marketing and finance. Prior to that, he was chief executive of Shaw Surgical Co.
The company did not say who Burke replaced.
In addition to Burke's appointment, Athena said it named Paul Mueggler, Ph.D., as its director of clinical operations and James R. Wilson as director of business development.

Mueggler has been a consultant to the company since February 1997. Wilson was most recently general manager of Century Building Products in Eugene, Oregon, a company formed to develop cement-fiber technology.
